summary: Baidu filed a 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return (US equivalent: Form 8-K/issuer buyback disclosure) dated September 17, 2026, reporting daily on-market repurchases of Class A ordinary shares for cancellation. From September 7 to 17, 2026, Baidu bought 4,011,900 shares at prices from HKD 86.909 to HKD 92.383, roughly 0.025% of shares outstanding per day. Shares repurchased are not yet cancelled; no board recommendation, advisor, price per share target, or closing condition is disclosed. Watch cancellation timing and pace of further buybacks.
